name: Personal-AI-Tools
title_zh: 十三件个人小工具，从记账到剪藏各管一摊
tagline_zh: 一个人攒的十三件小工具，记账、剪藏、整理笔记各管一摊，不追求大而全，每件都短到能一口气读完、改起来不心疼。
tagline_en: Thirteen small tools one person actually uses daily — bookkeeping, clipping, note tidying — each short enough to.
why_zh: 单文件为主，逻辑摊开给你看，想改哪句改哪句，不用先读懂一整个框架。
why_en: Mostly single-file, logic laid bare — edit one line without first digesting a whole framework.
limit_zh: 十三件是别人按自己习惯攒的，未必对上你的流程；没有统一入口和文档，得逐个翻仓库；部分依赖特定模型或本地环境。
limit_en: Thirteen tools built around someone else's habits, no unified entry or docs — you dig through the repo and patch missing deps yourself.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Thirteen personal AI tools, one job each
